notes.title: Update Notes For Aug 18
notes.notes:
With this small update, I have introduced a fix for the inspector tool bug. If the cursor was on the level area while the player was inspecting a memory fragment, the memory fragment was not displayed unless the mouse cursor was away from the board, or otherwise, the memory fragment had to be inspected using the cursor.

- David

notes.title: Update Notes For Dec 10
notes.notes:
Hey,

In this update, I've added a new option in the gameplay settings called [b]"Unlimited Moves"[/b] which allows you to progress through levels without counting steps. If you found limited movements annoying, now you can disable it. Additionally, this update includes a small UX feature:  when you manually change levels from the level manager, the manager will automatically close, letting you continue playing without extra clicks.

That's all for now. Until the next update, Cheers!

David

notes.title: Update Notes For Dec 2
notes.notes:
Tiny Patch for Development Console

This minor update introduces a new feature: you can now close the development console using the ESC key. This is particularly useful if the console is opened accidentally. Previously, the console could only be closed using the "exit" command or by pressing the TAB key. However, there was no prompt informing users about these methods. Additionally, I've added a message for unknown commands entered in the console, complete with helpful instructions.

Best,
David

notes.title: Return of the Host is Now Available on Steam
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to unveil the mind-bending puzzle game you've been waiting for – "Return of the Host" which is now officially released on Steam! Prepare to immerse yourself in a world of twisted puzzles, strategic challenges, and an exhilarating storyline that will keep you hooked.

"Return of the Host" introduces a fresh take on the classic Sokoban puzzle genre. Get ready to push your strategic thinking to the limits as you navigate through intricately designed levels. Each puzzle is a masterpiece of cunning design, presenting you with increasingly complex obstacles and mechanics to overcome.

Are you up for a true puzzle challenge? "Return of the Host" offers a variety of brain-teasing levels that will test your logic and problem-solving skills. From manipulating objects to outwitting clever traps, every move counts as you work your way through a labyrinth of challenges.

Immerse yourself in a captivating storyline as you embark on a journey filled with mystery and discovery. Uncover the secrets of the enigmatic Host and the world they inhabit. As you progress, the narrative unfolds, guiding your steps and adding a layer of depth to your puzzling adventure.

🎉 Grab "Return of the Host" on Steam now and embark on a journey of twisted puzzles and excitement! 

Thank you for your support, and may your mind stay sharp as you navigate the puzzles that await!

Best regards,
David
